caption:
And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.

Surah Al-Ankaboot (29:69). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.
